verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an SDK/CLI search runtime like Moss, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out setting. The on-device and local-query capabilities are a different feature and do not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
